about_the_game:
A Space for the Unbound - Original Soundtrack
Original music by Mojiken Studio's award-winning composer Masdito "ittou" Bachtiar, Christabel Annora, and various artists.
Featuring 72 tracks that will make you "spacedive" into the emotional journey of Atma and Raya.
